messages:
carmen: preparing a config-only push tonight (change window 23:30-00:15 PT). primary goal: reduce tail latency by tightening batch fill behavior and slightly raising routing floors. planned canary 1% targeted to non-critical routes.
deploy-bot: queued deploy_id=deploy-1758001111 type=config-only target=prod canary=1%
lee: oncall here, watching traces and SLO dashboards. subscribe to alerts.
niya: paste the config snippet we're pushing so we have it in thread:
```yaml
routing:
  min_route_weight_pct: 3
  priority_policy: latency-focused
batching:
  max_batch_tokens: 3072
  max_batch_size: 36
  batch_fill_timeout_ms: 9
  per_request_bypass_threshold: 18
timeouts:
  head_ms: 950
  stream_idle_ms: 30000
```
carmen: launching canary -> 1% to tweak-variant
deploy-bot: canary live: tweak receives 1% traffic (low-traffic cohorts)
obs-bot: canary metrics (6m): p50=40ms, p95=155ms, p99=312ms, 5xx=0.00%
lee: small tail skew on tenant "vectorly" — p99 ~510ms in a couple traces, looks like single huge requests waiting ~120ms for a batch to form. no errors.
niya: looks like batch_fill_timeout_ms=9 may be too long for those single-request patterns. suggestion: reduce batch_fill_timeout_ms to 5ms for the tweak variant and add per_request_wait_ms=6 to cap how long an individual request will block. do we hotpatch?
carmen: pause ramp. agree to hotpatch tweak only. include explicit revert command in the hotpatch notes.
deploy-bot: recommended hotpatch command: `/deploy config-only --patch '{"batching":{"batch_fill_timeout_ms":5,"per_request_wait_ms":6}}' --to prod --variant=tweak --canary 1%'`
deploy-bot: hotpatch started: patch_id=patch-1758002001 status=canarying
obs-bot: hotpatch canary metrics (4m): p50=37ms, p95=142ms, p99(vectorly)=220ms, 5xx=0.00%
lee: tail looks much better. no regression in other tenants. propose ramp to 25% over 12m.
niya: included rollback instructions in the deploy ticket: `/deploy rollback deploy-1758001111` or reapply cfg hash cfg-7b9e. also added a short playbook for oncall with the exact commands.
carmen: ramping patch-1758002001 -> 25%
deploy-bot: ramp in progress: target 25% over 12m
obs-bot: reached 25% (13m): p95 stable, p99 improved relative to baseline by ~30ms, no error increase.
lee: setting rollback triggers: any tenant 5xx > 0.45% OR sustained p99 delta +200ms for 5m. if hit, execute `/deploy rollback deploy-1758001111` and unpin immediately.
niya: pinning config cfg-7b9e to variant v20 for 24h as a protective measure. note in release: hotpatched batch_fill_timeout and per_request_wait to reduce head-of-line waits for single-request workloads.
revert-bot: reminder: to unpin run `revert-bot unpin --config cfg-7b9e --variant v20` after rollback completion.
carmen: drafting release notes: "Config-only: routing.min_route_weight_pct set to 3, batching.max_batch_size 64->36, max_batch_tokens 4096->3072, batch_fill_timeout_ms 12->9 then hotpatched to 5 for canary, added per_request_bypass_threshold=18 and per_request_wait_ms=6 to limit per-request blocking. Pinned cfg-7b9e to v20 for 24h. Change window closed 23:47 PT."
lee: owners: deploy-owner=carmen, rollback-owner=lee. monitoring extended for 6h.
niya: thanks everyone. closing thread unless alerts fire. :white_check_mark:
